notes: Critical Speed Yaw now accepts either a direct curve radius in feet or a radius derived from chord and middle ordinate.
The calculator applies signed superelevation to the lateral factor, with positive banking toward the curve center and negative adverse banking.
Existing chord/middle-ordinate case data remains compatible, and Show Work identifies the active radius source and adjusted factor.
Full automated suite: 812 passed from the merged release commit.
The portable package was built from the merged private `main` commit with the bundled ffprobe runtime verified.
This release contains only the compiled portable application, checksum, release notes, and update manifest in the public release-only repository.
It does not publish application source, source history, CVS/NHTSA data, local caches, private keys, or case material.
